name: anvil
description: anvil — local Ethereum node for development. Part of Foundry. Fast, deterministic, for testing smart contracts.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/foundry-rs/foundry/releases/latest/download/foundry_nightly_linux_amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf foundry_nightly_linux_amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv anvil /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf forge cast foundry_nightly_linux_amd64.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
